title: Great Oxidation interval
titleZh: 大氧化阶段
summary: Atmospheric and oceanic oxygen rose in a prolonged transformation that changed planetary chemistry and the selective environment for life.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Oxygenation was episodic rather than a single instant
Local oceans followed different redox histories

title: Ediacaran macroscopic ecosystems
titleZh: 埃迪卡拉宏体生态系统
summary: Large, complex organisms became conspicuous in late Neoproterozoic seas before the Cambrian diversification of skeletonized animals.

evidenceItems.statement: Stratigraphic association with late Ediacaran environments

uncertaintyItems.statement: Biological affinities of many forms remain disputed
Preservational windows strongly structure the record

title: Cambrian radiation
titleZh: 寒武纪大辐射
summary: Animal body plans, ecological interactions and mineralized skeletons expanded rapidly in the early Cambrian fossil record.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Molecular divergences often predate obvious body fossils
The apparent tempo depends on sampling and preservation

title: Great Ordovician Biodiversification
titleZh: 奥陶纪生物多样化
summary: Marine taxonomic and ecological diversity increased across many groups, building more complex Paleozoic ecosystems.

evidenceItems.statement: Expansion of reef and tiering structures

uncertaintyItems.statement: Regional pulses are asynchronous
Observed richness is sensitive to rock and collection availability

title: Modelled crown-Embryophyta divergence
titleZh: 胚胎植物冠群的模型分化时间
summary: A fossil-calibrated molecular clock estimates a middle Cambrian–Early Ordovician origin for crown land plants; it does not directly date fossil first appearances or terrestrial ecosystem expansion.

evidenceItems.statement: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock using 37 fossil calibrations

uncertaintyItems.statement: Divergence estimates are sensitive to clock models and fossil-calibration strategy
Modelled crown divergence is not a direct fossil first appearance or an ecosystem-expansion date

title: Fish–tetrapod transition and terrestrialization
titleZh: 鱼类—四足动物转型与陆地化
summary: A mosaic transition from finned aquatic vertebrates to limbed tetrapods unfolded across freshwater and marginal habitats.

evidenceItems.statement: Skulls combining aquatic and terrestrial features

uncertaintyItems.statement: Limbs initially evolved in animals that remained substantially aquatic
Trackway and body-fossil records do not align perfectly

title: Amniote diversification
titleZh: 羊膜动物分化
summary: Early amniotes split into the major lineages that would later produce mammals and reptiles, including birds.

evidenceItems.statement: Reproductive and skeletal adaptations inferred from phylogeny

uncertaintyItems.statement: The earliest members are rare
Exact divergence dates depend on tree calibration

title: End-Permian mass extinction
titleZh: 二叠纪末大灭绝
summary: The most severe known Phanerozoic biotic crisis reorganized marine and terrestrial ecosystems near the Permian–Triassic boundary.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Kill mechanisms interacted across ocean and land
Regional ecological collapse and recovery were asynchronous

title: Triassic ecological recovery
titleZh: 三叠纪生态恢复
summary: Ecosystems rebuilt in multiple pulses after the end-Permian crisis, eventually supporting new marine and terrestrial radiations.

evidenceItems.statement: Recovery of reef and pelagic systems

uncertaintyItems.statement: Recovery duration differs by metric and region
Repeated Early Triassic environmental stress delayed some communities

title: Dinosaur radiation
titleZh: 恐龙辐射
summary: Dinosaurs emerged within a broader archosaur radiation and became ecologically dominant only through a prolonged Triassic-to-Jurassic transition.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Earliest dinosaur identifications are contested
Dominance followed origin by millions of years

title: Early angiosperm crown-lineage diversification estimates
titleZh: 被子植物主要冠群的早期分化估计
summary: A metacalibrated time-tree estimates Early Cretaceous diversification of major flowering-plant crown lineages; it is not direct evidence of fossil first appearances or ecological dominance.

evidenceItems.statement: Metacalibrated crown-lineage estimates from 137 fossil calibrations

uncertaintyItems.statement: Estimated ages depend on fossil calibrations and molecular-clock models

title: K–Pg mass extinction
titleZh: 白垩纪—古近纪灭绝
summary: An impact-driven global crisis ended the non-avian dinosaurs and many marine groups while opening ecological space for surviving lineages.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Deccan volcanism contributed background environmental stress
Survival and recovery patterns varied among regions and clades

title: Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum
titleZh: 古新世—始新世极热事件
summary: A geologically rapid carbon release and warming interval coincided with major migrations, body-size shifts and marine turnover.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Carbon sources and release pacing remain debated
Onset and recovery durations depend on archive resolution

title: Early Eocene perissodactyl radiation and dispersal
titleZh: 早始新世奇蹄目辐射与扩散
summary: Odd-toed ungulates appeared and rapidly diversified into many of the dominant large-herbivore roles of Eocene northern continents.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The precise ancestral group and relationships of early branches remain debated
First appearances reflect sampling as well as evolution

title: Eocene–Oligocene transition
titleZh: 始新世—渐新世转型
summary: Global cooling, Antarctic glaciation and habitat reorganization coincided with major mammalian and marine faunal turnover.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Immigration, climate and habitat change contributed differently by region
Ecological replacement was not a simple one-to-one competition

title: Late Miocene C4-vegetation expansion
titleZh: 晚中新世 C4 植被扩张
summary: Fossil tooth-enamel isotopes record a widespread, regionally asynchronous increase in C4-plant biomass; they do not alone demonstrate open grassland or faunal adaptation.

evidenceItems.statement: Fossil tooth-enamel δ13C records from four continents

uncertaintyItems.statement: The increase occurred earlier at lower latitudes and was not globally synchronous
Isotope-inferred C4 biomass is not equivalent to open-grassland dominance

title: Quaternary megafaunal extinctions
titleZh: 第四纪巨型动物灭绝
summary: Large-bodied vertebrates disappeared in geographically staggered waves during the late Quaternary.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Relative effects of human pressure and climate vary by continent
Last-appearance dates underestimate true extinction when sampling is sparse

title: Early Homo Eurasian dispersals
titleZh: 早期人属向欧亚扩散
summary: Early Homo populations expanded into Eurasia in multiple episodes that remain incompletely resolved by fossils and archaeology.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Sparse fossils leave route and population identity uncertain
Dispersal was a series of events rather than one migration

title: Homo sapiens dispersal and archaic admixture
titleZh: 智人扩散与古老人群基因交流
summary: Later Homo sapiens dispersals included contact and gene flow with Neanderthal and Denisovan populations.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Dates, routes and the number of contact episodes remain model-dependent
Genetic contact is not equivalent to one migration event

title: Dapingian cryptospore assemblage
titleZh: 大坪期隐孢子组合
summary: Five cryptospore genera from a source-dated 473–471 Ma Argentine assemblage provide early evidence of plants on emerged land without identifying a bryophyte crown group.

evidenceItems.statement: Naked and envelope-enclosed monads and tetrads from one biostratigraphically controlled horizon

uncertaintyItems.statement: Cryptospores do not identify a crown bryophyte lineage or the exact place and time of embryophyte origin

title: Late Ordovician spore-mass fragments
titleZh: 晚奥陶世含孢子团植物碎片
clades: Early land plants; liverwort affinity tentative
summary: Caradoc-age fragments from an Oman core preserve dense cryptospore masses and probable sporangial covering, directly linking early spores to land plants while leaving crown affinity unresolved.

evidenceItems.statement: Twelve fragments contain permanent tetrads or dyads, and some retain presumed sporangial covering

uncertaintyItems.statement: Caradoc is a legacy regional unit, so the Sandbian–Katian display window is deliberately broad
Lamellate spore walls suggest liverwort affinity, but missing elaters and unresolved early-land-plant topology prevent a crown assignment

title: Asteroxylon rooting-system reconstruction
titleZh: 星木属根系三维重建
summary: Evidence-based 3D reconstructions separate three axis types in Asteroxylon mackiei and show an extinct anisotomous route to rooting axes without projecting that anatomy onto all lycophytes.

evidenceItems.statement: Independent serial-section and peel reconstructions recover leafy shoot, root-bearing and rooting axes

uncertaintyItems.statement: The reconstructed developmental mechanism belongs to Asteroxylon and is not asserted for all Lycophyta

title: Givetian Metzgeriothallus body fossils
titleZh: 吉维特期 Metzgeriothallus 植物体化石
regions: Catskill Delta succession, eastern New York
summary: Givetian shale and siltstone lenses preserve thalloid Metzgeriothallus sharonae gametophytes and an associated sporophyte capsule, a liverwort body-fossil record rather than a crown-origin date.

evidenceItems.statement: Polarized-light study reveals bifurcating thalli with a medial costa and an associated sporophyte capsule

uncertaintyItems.statement: A Givetian occurrence cannot date crown Marchantiophyta or prove absence from older rocks
The fossil morphology is not generalized to all living or extinct liverwort lineages

title: Extant gymnosperm phylogenomic backbone
titleZh: 现生裸子植物系统基因组骨架
summary: A nuclear phylogenomic analysis spanning all living gymnosperm families recovered a Gnepine topology and a cycads-plus-Ginkgo branch while leaving fossils and chronological ranges outside the claim.

evidenceItems.statement: All 13 living gymnosperm families sampled across up to 1,308 nuclear loci

uncertaintyItems.statement: Gene-tree conflict and alternative subset results keep the Gnepine placement a published hypothesis rather than permanent consensus
The topology concerns sampled living lineages and supplies neither fossil ranges nor an extinct-seed-plant tree

title: 2011 model of living-cycad radiation
titleZh: 2011 年现生苏铁辐射模型
summary: A 2011 fossil-calibrated model placed most sampled living cycad species within the last roughly 12 million years; later fossil-integrated studies require a less synchronous and more deeply rooted interpretation.

evidenceItems.statement: Fossil-calibrated timetrees of sampled living cycad species and genera

uncertaintyItems.statement: Later fossil, tectonic and total-evidence treatments recover older deep nodes and weaken a simple globally synchronous radiation
The 12 Ma window concerns sampled living radiations, not Cycadales origin or fossil first appearance

title: Modelled crown age of extant Cycadaceae
titleZh: 现生苏铁科冠群模型年龄
regions: Global Cycas plastome sample with Palawan calibration
summary: A combined plastome, fossil and tectonic calibration scheme yielded mean crown-age estimates of 69.31 and 42.88 Ma under different tree priors, without converting either model result into a fossil range.

evidenceItems.statement: Whole-plastome phylogeny evaluated under alternative fossil, tectonic and tree-prior schemes

uncertaintyItems.statement: Calibration scheme and tree prior substantially change the estimate, with underconstrained alternatives spanning much wider ages
The result concerns the crown of living Cycadaceae, not all Cycadales and not a directly observed fossil first appearance

title: Modelled contraction of cycad latitudinal range
titleZh: 苏铁纬度分布收缩模型
summary: A total-evidence biogeographic model inferred broad Cretaceous–Palaeogene latitudes followed by contraction toward the present tropical–subtropical distribution, while exposing how strongly fossils change extinction estimates.

evidenceItems.statement: 321 living species, 60 fossil leaf species and time-stratified process-based biogeography

uncertaintyItems.statement: The broad 66–11.63 Ma display window summarizes a modelled transition and is not one dated extinction pulse
Fossil omissions, uncertain placements and model assumptions can alter dates, ancestral areas and inferred local extirpation counts

title: Tiaojishan Ginkgo-like fossil wood
titleZh: 天义山组银杏样化石木材
summary: One anatomically diagnosed fossil wood from the Middle–Late Jurassic transition records a Ginkgo-like xylem combination while remaining an isolated organ taxon rather than a whole plant or phylum first appearance.

evidenceItems.statement: Specimen PB22285, Tiaojishan stratigraphy and wood anatomy illustrated in transverse, tangential and radial section

uncertaintyItems.statement: The isolated wood cannot be safely linked to any particular co-occurring Ginkgo foliage species
A 153–165 Ma specimen does not establish the first appearance of Ginkgophyta or continuous survival of Ginkgo biloba from the Jurassic

title: Modelled hemispheric pattern in extant conifer nodes
titleZh: 现生针叶树节点的半球模型格局
regions: Northern and Southern Hemisphere living-species sample
summary: A 489-species time tree found older combined median node ages in predominantly Southern Hemisphere conifer lineages than in sampled Northern Hemisphere lineages, a relative living-lineage pattern rather than a fossil range.

evidenceItems.statement: 489 living conifer species and 16 fossil calibrations yield combined medians of 8.7 versus 5.2 Ma

uncertaintyItems.statement: The displayed endpoints are comparative median node ages, not the duration of one radiation event or the origin of Araucariaceae
Absolute ages may be biased young, Gnetales were excluded and the proposed climate mechanism remains interpretive
